# NVIDIA Canary-Qwen 2.5B

- Official repository: https://huggingface.co/nvidia/canary-qwen-2.5b
- Pinned revision: `b1469e1bba1cfe140205529c79c434ca47180960`
- License: CC-BY-4.0
- License text: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode

The official model card describes English-only ASR use and a maximum training audio duration of
40 seconds. EchoForge therefore marks this backend experimental and plans overlapping 35-second
windows. The exact NVIDIA configuration and safetensors artifact identities are pinned in the
manifest.
